unit: SDK Abstractions freeze and ApiCompat report
notes: Freezes the versioned v7 Abstractions surface without changing a public member: the committed PublicAPI.Shipped/Unshipped text (nine exported types, 67 declarations) is copied verbatim to docs/port/p6-008-frozen-api.txt and protected by a new architecture test. Produces the reviewed v6-to-v7 Microsoft.DotNet.ApiCompat 11.0.100 report against the published PlayniteSDK 6.18.0 baseline (package sha256 63ae943bf226a782738d3d6b9977dcb77861e5d2ea1aadcf620332618c93e236; assembly sha256 ce7511941aba4d4b17dd7b226fadfd0ecefdf51ab73775b25631089fd7542fc7): 218 CP0001 missing-type differences, zero member-level differences, each classified in p6-008-apicompat-classification.tsv as adapted (26), deferred (178) or excluded (14), with no silent or rebaselined break. The p6-006/p6-007 host surfaces stay in Core because moving them would edit foreign-owned p6-006/p6-007 files and protected PublicAPI/api-baseline files, IMainViewAPI still depends on Core Game, and ADR-018/ADR-023 scope those UI extension points as adapted and defer their freeze; the report records them as adapted rather than claiming v6 compatibility. Adds 12 fake-host contract tests, one per SDK interface across Abstractions, Core.Hosting, Core.UriHandling and Core.Descriptions, with a reflection coverage test that fails on an uncovered interface. Verifies Core references only Playnite.SDK.Abstractions and neither Core nor Abstractions has a direct or transitive Avalonia/UI dependency. No protected declaration, baseline, oracle or aggregate is edited.
